original_description: Reflections Licensed Studio is for brands that hold a signed Reflections license to a talent's likeness. A signed license and an approved source are required before anything can be created: choose an accepted license and approved source, create three watermarked candidates by default, request rights changes, submit an exact final for talent approval, and download the released asset with its certificate. Available in English.
